tagline: A bank rebuilding value through disciplined operations and risk management
hero_kpi_rationale: Post-tax Return on Tangible Equity is the central KPI of Deutsche Bank's current strategy, used to measure shareholder value creation despite a demanding banking environment. It is the priority performance driver displayed in quarterly reports.

kpis.name: Return on Tangible Equity (after-tax)
kpis.explanation: Measures how much the bank earns relative to its tangible equity after taxes.
kpis.description: Post-tax RoTE on a 6-month basis stands at 3.9% in 2024 versus 6.8% in 2023, impacted by a provision related to the Postbank acquisition.
kpis.signal: RoTE declining despite stable revenues, impacted by costs and litigation.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income received and paid, relative to productive assets.
kpis.description: NIM declines to 1.3% in H1 2024 versus 1.5% in H1 2023, reflecting pressure on net interest margins.
kpis.signal: Margin compression despite a higher rate environment.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of costs in the bank's total revenues.
kpis.description: The ratio deteriorated to 78.1% in H1 2024 versus 73.3% in H1 2023, driven by elevated costs tied to restructuring.
kpis.signal: Cost-to-Income ratio deterioration despite stable revenues.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key indicator of financial soundness and shock resilience.
kpis.description: CET1 ratio maintained at 13.5% in June 2024, in line with the 13% target, or 200 bp above the MDA threshold.
kpis.signal: CET1 stable despite regulatory pressures and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Total Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues after deduction of direct charges.
kpis.description: Total net revenues reach EUR 15.4 billion over 6 months, up 2% versus EUR 15.1 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: Modest revenue growth, driven by commissions.

kpis.name: Commissions and Fee Income
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by banking services: asset management, transactions, etc.
kpis.description: 12% year-over-year growth in commission revenues across all business lines.
kpis.signal: Double-digit commission growth, a sign of strategic momentum.

kpis.name: Adjusted Costs
kpis.description: Adjusted costs stand at EUR 10.1 billion in H1 2024 versus EUR 10.3 billion in H1 2023.
kpis.signal: Reduction in adjusted costs despite inflation and investments.

kpis.name: Headcount (Full-Time Equivalent)
kpis.description: 89,470 full-time equivalent employees as of June 30, 2024, versus 87,055 one year earlier.
kpis.signal: Modest increase in headcount despite cost pressures.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Increased competition from neobanks and fintechs
risks.score_rationale: Referenced in the 'Risks Relating to Technology, Data and Innovation' section, moderate language but recurring threat from new entrants, rising trend, high weight due to digital transformation impact.

risks.title: Escalating risks from autonomous AI
risks.score_rationale: Present in 'Risks Relating to Technology, Data and Innovation', strong language: 'autonomous decision making', 'undetected mistakes', rising trend, critical category due to operational and regulatory impact potential.

risks.title: Mounting regulatory pressure on capital and liquidity
risks.score_rationale: Discussed in 'Risks Relating to Regulation and Supervision', strong language: 'prohibitions', 'increased requirements', stable to rising trend, high weight due to direct business model impact.

risks.title: Heightened cybersecurity vulnerabilities linked to digitalization
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in 'Risks Relating to Technology, Data and Innovation', moderate language but implicit threat discussion, rising trend, strategic category with growing exposure.

risks.title: Elevated exposure to litigation and regulatory sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in 'Risks Relating to Litigation, Regulatory Enforcement Matters', strong language: 'material damages', 'criminal prosecution', stable trend, high weight due to potential costs and reputational impact.

risks.title: Rising complexity of divergent ESG standards
risks.score_rationale: Present in 'Climate Change and Other Risks Relating to ESG', clear language on compliance costs, rising trend, growing weight with global regulatory pressure.

risks.title: Dependence on critical technology talent
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in technology risks, indirect but logical business language, rising trend, moderate but growing weight with digitalization.

ai_positioning.summary: Deutsche Bank adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, focusing on specific use cases in corporate services and compliance. No massive rollout or bank-wide AI strategy has been announced.
evidence: AI mentioned in reports only through compliance and risk analysis tools
No references to customer-facing AI products or public APIs
R&D investments not detailed, no mention of AI cloud or technology partnerships
